conviction_note: The one company-level number that decides this print is the FY26 guide: $4-6M revenue needs H2 of $2.8-4.8M against H1 $1.2M, a June-30 backlog of only $1.0M and a HiRain production start the Q2 release moved to 'beginning of 2027'; last year this same Q3 release cut the full-year guide and the stock fell 10.3%. That leans negative, but the stock already sits 7% off its 52-week low, 30% under the September $0.60 offering, near its cash, with 14 days to cover, so p_up is only 44 on an abs move of 10 (expected -1.2), smaller than the findings' sum of -1.8 because the squeeze and near-cash floor are carried in p_up as well as in their own finding.
bar: Revenue line: FY2026 company guide $4-6M revenue and adj. EBITDA loss $28-31M, reaffirmed 2026-08-06 (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/arbe-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-302844826.html). Q3 2026 revenue consensus ~$0.85M and EPS -$0.06, Q4 ~$2.1M, single source (Benzinga, https://www.benzinga.com/quote/ARBE/earnings-forecasts, via search snippet; page 403 on fetch), so the quarter-level bar is unconfirmed by a second source and the reported-quarter finding is capped small. Implied analyst FY ~= 1.2 + 0.85 + 2.1 = ~$4.15M, i.e. at the bottom of the guide.
positioning_check: Short interest 11,197,692 shares at the 2026-10-30 FINRA settlement (+414k vs 10-15), 14.29 days to cover on 783k average daily volume, ~8.7% of shares outstanding (https://equibles.com/stocks/arbe/short-interest, fetched 2026-11-18); 11-13 settlement not yet published. Borrow fee ~4.4% per curvedtrading snippet. No usable option chain: ATM legs not two-sided, skew null, put/call OI 0.11 (31k total OI, call-heavy). Tape: spot $0.4194, -17.3% over 5 days, -10.2% over 20 days, -77% from the 52-week high, +7% above the 52-week low.

findings.finding: The reaffirmed FY2026 guide ($4-6M revenue, $28-31M adj. EBITDA loss) requires H2 revenue of $2.8-4.8M against H1 of $1.2M (Q1 $0.5M + Q2 $0.7M) and a June-30 backlog of only $1.0M (down from $1.3M in the Feb-26 release), while the Q2 release says HiRain's L4 production is now 'planned for the beginning of 2027' (the Feb release said Hirain had placed chipset POs with 2026 delivery dates); H1 adj. EBITDA loss was $18.6M (9.9 + 8.7), so the EBITDA guide needs H2 losses of $4.7-6.2M a quarter against $8.7M in Q2. A cut to the revenue guide at this print is likely, and analyst FY (~$4.15M) sits at the guide's low end, so a range below $4M lands under consensus.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 2025 release (2025-11-17, bmo) cut FY25 revenue guide to $1-2M on 'timing shift of certain NRE programs': close 1.45 -> 1.30, -10.3%. Q4 2025 (2026-02-26), first FY26 guide $4-6M: 1.03 -> 0.932, -9.5%. Q1 2026 (2026-05-28) reaffirm: 1.23 -> 1.21, -1.6%. Q2 2026 (2026-08-06) reaffirm + revenue beat: 0.706 -> 0.757, +7.2%. (Yahoo v8 daily closes.)
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: the stock is at all-time lows and analysts have already parked FY at the guide's bottom (~$4.15M), so a 'low end' reaffirm is in. What is not in is a cut below $4M: if the market held that, Q4 consensus would sit near $1M rather than ~$2.1M, and the backlog/H2 arithmetic would be in the preview copy, which carries only 'delisting risk' framing. Shrunk from a larger size for the crowded short (14 DTC) and the near-cash valuation.
findings.independence: Same Q2 document carries backlog, guide and HiRain timing (one finding). Independent: the Q3 2025 release cut guidance at the same point last year (https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_668e8b799c602759111145a5a40df3f1/arberobotics/news/2025-11-17_Arbe_Announces_Q3_2025_Financial_161.pdf); the Feb-26 2026 release gave backlog $1.3M and the 2026-delivery POs (https://d1io3yog0oux5.cloudfront.net/_25179165d2fc3addd1cc91ba4c918c61/arberobotics/news/2026-02-26_Arbe_Announces_Fourth_Quarter_and_Full_Year_2025_171.pdf); Q2 call said no timing guidance on OEM wins, adoption cycles 'taking longer than expected' (https://www.webull.com/news/15396607175304192).

findings.finding: Q3 revenue bar is low: consensus ~$0.85M (Benzinga, single source) against Q2's $0.7M, which itself beat a $0.54M consensus; the June-30 backlog of $1.0M plus defense deliveries 'from its production line' (Q2 release) make roughly $0.8-1.0M plausible, i.e. the reported quarter is near the bar, not the swing factor.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 revenue beat ($0.70M vs $0.54M) with reaffirmed guide: +7.2%. Q3 2025 revenue miss ($0.25M, ~64% under Zacks) with guide cut: -10.3%; reported-quarter and guide moved together each time.
findings.why_not_priced: Little to price: a sub-$1M quarter on a $55-65M market cap moves only through what it implies for Q4. Capped small because the bar has one source.
findings.independence: Backlog and defense deliveries from the Q2 release (shared with finding 1). Consensus from Benzinga snippet only (https://www.benzinga.com/quote/ARBE/earnings-forecasts).

findings.finding: A ~$15M registered direct (833,334 shares plus 24.16M pre-funded warrants at $0.60) priced 2026-09-25 and closed ~09-28, inside Q3, so Q3-end cash should be roughly $41.9M - ~$7-8M burn + ~$14M net = ~$47-49M, with the 15% cost cut 'fully visible in Q3' and a burn target under $7M; against ~129M shares outstanding (11.2M short = 8.7%) plus pre-funded warrants, the stock at $0.42 trades at roughly $55-65M, close to cash. The money buys runway, not a corroborated ramp (backlog fell), so it is a small positive on runway clarity, not a growth signal.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Offering day 2026-09-25: -9.5% intraday to $0.61; the stock is now ~30% under the offer price. Jan-2026 $18.5M raise at $1.40 preceded the Feb print's -9.5%.
findings.why_not_priced: The raise itself is priced (and then some: -30% since). What the print adds is the first balance sheet after it and the first quarter with the full cost cut; if the market were valuing the cash, the stock would not sit near or below net cash per fully diluted share.
findings.independence: Cash $41.9M and the burn target from the Q2 release (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/arbe-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-302844826.html); runway 4-5 quarters estimate at ~$9M burn in the Oct-29 preview column (https://briefglance.com/articles/the-innovation-penalty-arbe-robotics-and-the-race-against-the-ticker).

findings.finding: Series A convertible bonds ($24.0M current liability, $25.1M funds held in escrow at June 30) mature 2026-12-31, also the extended deadline for the escrow release conditions (one of which is winning a single-supplier supply tender/contract); the Q3 call is the last scheduled occasion to say whether the escrow releases (+~$24M of usable cash, e.g. if the Sep-8 HiRain L3 selection qualifies) or the bonds are redeemed out of escrow (cash-neutral, but the funding is lost).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior print turned on the escrow. The Dec-2025 extension and $15.7M follow-on of the bonds were not print events.
findings.why_not_priced: No preview or wire item mentions the escrow; reported cash ($41.9M) excludes it. If the market expected release, the $25M (about 40% of market cap) would appear in bull cases. Redemption is the base case and is cash-neutral, hence near zero; the right tail is release.
findings.independence: Q2 release balance sheet shows $24.0M bonds current and $25.1M escrow (https://www.prnewswire.com/il/news-releases/arbe-announces-second-quarter-2026-financial-results-302844826.html); bondholder approval of the 2026-12-31 maturity and 4.35% rate summarised in search results citing the 2025-12-22 6-K.

findings.finding: Shareholders approved on 2026-09-09 a reverse split at a board-set ratio targeting ~$3.00 a share (about 1:7 at today's price), to be done if needed for Nasdaq compliance; the minimum-bid cure deadline is 2027-02-14 (one aggregator says 2027-04-12), so a ratio announcement with or around the Q3 results is possible, and microcap reverse splits are usually sold.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: None on this name; no split has been executed.
findings.why_not_priced: The approval is public; the timing is not. Only matters if the release or call names the ratio or date, which it may not.
findings.independence: Nasdaq 180-day extension to 2027-02-14 per the Oct-29 preview column (https://briefglance.com/articles/the-innovation-penalty-arbe-robotics-and-the-race-against-the-ticker).

findings.finding: Short interest rose to 11.2M shares (8.7% of shares outstanding) at the 2026-10-30 settlement, 14.3 days to cover on 783k ADV, into a -17% five-day slide that has no news cause found; a guide that merely holds the low end, or any program/escrow news, meets a short base that needs two to three weeks of volume to exit.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026 reaffirm with a small beat lifted the stock +7.2% from a depressed level; Sep 2026 volume spike (12.2M ADV in the 09-15 settlement) followed the Sep-8 HiRain L3 news.
findings.why_not_priced: Days-to-cover is a mechanism, not information; it is only partly offset by the run-up already being negative. If shorts had covered into the print the 11-13 settlement would show it (estimated flat at ~10.95M by the same site).
findings.independence: Tape from the sealed baseline (-17.28% 5d, avg volume 794k). Borrow fee 4.4% per https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/arbe/ (snippet).

baseline_tension: The guide arithmetic leans negative, which agrees with the -17% five-day and -10% twenty-day run-up, so part of it is in the price; the crowded short (14 DTC) and a market cap near cash cut against it, and there is no skew to read.
lessons_applied: Lesson 5 (an unexplained microcap drawdown is worth 0): the positioning/squeeze finding cut from +1.0 to +0.6, kept because short interest and days to cover are sourced numbers, not the drawdown itself.
Lesson 4 (financing is a question): the Sep raise buys runway, not a corroborated ramp (backlog fell to $1.0M), so the cash finding cut from +0.5 to +0.3.

Lesson 6 (verify the bar): the quarter-level consensus has one source, so the reported-quarter finding stays capped at +0.3; the guidance finding is measured against the company's own guide and stands at -2.5.
Lesson 7 (crowded short shrinks a negative): already applied in the draft to the guidance finding; not applied twice. p_up moved from 45 to 44 only because the positioning finding shrank.
